EGY.source: Central Bank of Egypt · EGP T-Bills Secondary Market
EGY.method: Daily weighted-average secondary-market yields on EGP Treasury bills by CBE residual-maturity bands. The source labels 61–91 days as 3 months, 92–182 days as 6 months and 274–365 days as 12 months; plotted at those corresponding existing app tenors.
EGY.retrieval: Reviewed the CBE official listing for secondary-market EGP T-bill executions dated 2026-10-06. The browser and build-host requests to the CBE page returned Request Rejected, so these dated values are stored as a reviewed seed until the official source can be fetched directly.

MYS.method: Daily closing trading yields for conventional Malaysian Government Securities benchmarks at provider-labelled 3-, 5-, 7- and 10-year terms. BNM marks the 5-year observation as last traded.
MYS.retrieval: Reviewed the dated official BNM Benchmark Yields page on 2026-10-20; it labels the table Trading Date 20 Oct 2026. Direct automated downloads returned HTTP 403 from the build host, so the automatic provider preserves this dated seed when blocked.

NZL.source: Reserve Bank of New Zealand · Wholesale Interest Rates (B2)
NZL.method: NZFMA indicative 5:10pm closing yields on benchmark New Zealand Government bonds at 1, 2, 5 and 10 years; daily, published with a one-business-day lag.
NZL.retrieval: Reviewed official B2 public webpage, government-bond columns only. Direct automated downloads returned HTTP 403 on the build host; the automatic provider retains this dated seed on failure.
